title.narrative: LG3 The Commonwealth Faith Festival: Peacebuilding through Faith

description.narrative: The Secretariat is a strong convener, with strategic partnerships across various stakeholder groups, including youth networks and international organizations. Drawing on decades of experience in capacity building, policy advocacy and intergenerational partnerships, the Secretariat is able to translate global commitments such as the SDGs into actionable initiatives that amplify youth leadership and foster inclusive societies. This is evidenced by the first iteration of the project, the Faith in the Commonwealth, which was a joint initiative between the Commonwealth and the Khalili Foundation to deliver Global Citizenship Education (GCED) and religious literacy in an interactive, practical and contemporary way. It builds on the Commonwealth’s investments in youth development and entrepreneurship, and in developing young people’s skills to build peace and prevent counter violent extremism. The project championed global citizenship education, improved intercultural and interfaith literacy, improved respect for diversity and supported youth in leading social change and building resilience in their societies. The second iteration, Commonwealth Faith Festival, was designed to provide continued support in the form of grants and capacity building opportunities to empower young peacebuilders to design and implement impactful, community-based peace initiatives. By engaging stakeholders and partners from the first iteration of the project, as well as CYPAN representatives and other youth stakeholders, the project aims to provide capacity building opportunities, comprehensive support and guidance as well as networking and leadership opportunities for young peacebuilders across the Commonwealth.
